subject: EngageProof pilot metrics & mutual action plan
body:
--Message 1 (Feb 07 2027 15:12 PST)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@engageproof.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: EngageProof pilot metrics & mutual action plan

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the same definition of success before we lock a short pilot:

Scope (proposed)
- 2-week pilot (production-like traffic shape) against your entity-extraction + prompt-completion routes
- Integrations: sample dataset ingest + ability to call Redwood’s hosted inference or a short-lived Dedicated pool as discussed

Core evaluation metrics (proposed gating criteria)
- Latency: 99th percentile <= 350ms for standard routes; target 99th <= 200ms for low-latency routes (see notes)
- Throughput: sustain an average of 40k tokens/minute across burst windows with <5% error rate
- Cost: target gross cost <= $0.006 / generated token (pilot accounting excludes embeddings)
- Quality: entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on your labeled holdout; human eval mean >= 4.2/5 on 150 blind prompts

Ownership (who does what)
- Ben Carter (me) — overall program owner, commercial cadence and MAP/contract coordination
- Monica Patel — onboarding/runbook owner (data ingest, test harness, SRE coordination)
- Stephanie Nguyen — performance tuning (batching, quantization recommendations, kernel configs)

Operational asks from EngageProof
- Provide a 5000-record sample (anonymized) and a labeled 500-record holdout for quality validation
- Point contact for engineering: Priya Sharma (Head of ML) + security contact for SOC2 questions

Deliverables we’ll provide
- Pilot runbook + test harness (load script + metric dashboards)
- MAP draft (attached) with timelines, acceptance criteria, and rollback clauses
- Short dedicated-config proposal and provisional costing for the pilot

Next steps
1) You confirm acceptance of the gating metrics above or suggest adjustments (reply to thread)
2) We’ll send a MAP and DocuSign for the pilot engagement (two-week target)
3) Monica will schedule a 60-min kickoff to align test data, access, and timeline

Attachments: engageproof-pilot-metrics-template.xlsx, MAP-ENG-4521.docx, redwood-security-brief.pdf

Thanks — I’ll hold Feb 14–18 for kickoff windows unless you prefer an earlier slot.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

--Message 2 (Feb 08 2027 09:30 PST)
From: Alex Monroe <alex@engageproof.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@engageproof.com>, legal@engageproof.com
Date: Tue, 8 Feb 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EngageProof pilot metrics & mutual action plan

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Priya and I reviewed internally; we like the structure. A few notes / asks before sign-off:

- Latency: for our real-time extraction endpoint we will need 99th <= 200ms for payloads <= 512 tokens. If that’s only achievable on a Dedicated pool that’s fine — we need to know the delta vs hosted.
- Cost: $0.006/token is a helpful target — can you confirm if that includes model + infra, or if there are surcharge line-items for Dedicated nodes?
- Quality: 500 labelled holdout is fine; we also want a small human review panel (10 reviewers) to sanity-check borderline cases during the pilot.
- Security: can you share the SOC2 summary; our security team will ask about data retention and audit logs.

We’ll have legal loop in on any MAP redlines. If we can get the MAP and an estimate by EOD Wednesday, I’ll push to have internal approval for a Feb 14 kickoff.

—Alex
Alex Monroe
VP Product, EngageProof
alex@engageproof.com

On Tue, Feb 8, 2027 at 07:12 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick follow.

--Message 3 (Feb 09 2027 11:05 PST)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@engageproof.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@engageproof.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EngageProof pilot metrics & mutual action plan

Alex — great questions. Quick answers and adjustments inline:

- Latency: we can commit to the 200ms 99th for the designated low-latency route when the traffic runs on a small Dedicated pool for the pilot. Hosted (multi-tenant) SLO remains at 350ms 99th for the same payload sizes; we’ll document failover behavior if dedicated capacity is exhausted.
- Cost: the $0.006/token target represents our estimated on-prem-token-equivalent unit cost (model execution + amortized infra) for the model family we discussed. Dedicated nodes have a small premium (we’ll show both hosted and dedicated pilot cost rows in the MAP). Pilot credits can offset the premium for the two-week window.
- Quality: agree to the human review panel — Monica, can you own coordinating 10 reviewers and the review rubric?
- Security: attached is the SOC2 short-form and our standard retention/audit summary. Karthik, looping you for any further compliance details we should provide to EngageProof.

I’ve attached an updated MAP with the dedicated-hosted lanes and a provisional pricing table. I’ll also create the test harness repo and share access before the kickoff.

Next concrete steps
- Alex: confirm stakeholders and any legal must-haves by EOD Wednesday
- EngageProof: upload the 5000 sample + 500 holdout to the secure intake link we’ll provide
- Redwood: send DocuSign for MAP and provision Dedicated pool (pending signature)

If we get sign-off on Wed, Monica will run the kickoff 60-min session on Feb 14 (proposed).

—Ben

--Message 4 (Feb 10 2027 10:02 PST)
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EngageProof pilot metrics & mutual action plan

Short internal note: I’ll own the pilot runbook and coordinate the reviewer panel. I’ll schedule the kickoff for Feb 14 @ 11:00 PT and send calendar invites to Alex/Priya once we have the MAP signed.

Action items I’ll take immediately:
- Create pilot runbook (template based on engageproof-pilot-metrics-template.xlsx)
- Prep human review rubric and recruit 10 reviewers
- Create secure upload link for sample data and send to Alex once legal confirms NDA pieces

Karthik — please confirm we can send the redwood-security-brief.pdf to EngageProof security; if you want additional artifacts I’ll attach them to the initial intake email.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0125
